lecture-videos.name: Lecture videos
lecture-videos.description: Source-grounded narrated lessons and local study players.
lecture-videos.requests: making a lecture video, turning course slides or class notes into a narrated lesson, or creating a study video
lecture-videos.requires: Local command and file access on the computer running Am I Cooked.

courses.name: Course planning
courses.description: Grades, deadlines, announcements and course files.
courses.requests: checking grades or deadlines, finding course files, explaining or summarizing lectures, quizzing the student on their slides, or giving an Am I Cooked overview
courses.requires: A Brightspace login for live course material.

updates.name: Updates
updates.description: Update the app and skills, manually or with automatic patch updates.
updates.requests: finding Am I Cooked features, updating the app, or managing automatic patch updates
updates.requires: An installed app with local command access.

setup.name: Setup
setup.description: Connect your school and AI apps.
setup.requests: setting up or troubleshooting Am I Cooked, connecting an AI app, or signing in to Brightspace
setup.requires: Local command access and Chrome or Edge.
